interpretation: Verdicts describe pinned public source only, not a live binary or an upstream provider. Unresolved is not contradicted. No incompatible complete chains were established.
reference_bound: At most two direct references from the predeclared discovered anchors. No memblock internals or re-anchored architecture reconstruction. The coordinator retained the original bound and accepted allocation API effects only where size/base flow is explicit.

dynamic_reservation_producer.claim: The pinned generic reserved-memory allocator produces the dynamic reservation's base and size; the CONSYS early callback consumes its base rather than allocating it.
dynamic_reservation_producer.boundary: API-level source effect only. The declared 0x200000 size and alignment, no-map and [0x40000000,0xc0000000) allocation window reach the allocator; its returned base and the parsed size populate reserved_mem before the matching callback stores base in gConEmiPhyBase. Actual live base, successful runtime reservation, architecture override exclusion and memblock implementation are not established.
dynamic_reservation_producer.missing: No missing edge for the selected allocator-API-level source claim; live execution and deeper allocator behavior remain outside scope.
dynamic_reservation_producer.next_discriminator: For any runtime/provider proposal, independently establish the active implementation and actual allocated base/size without assuming this public source exactly matches Gemian.

consys_power_reset_owner.claim: The common platform entry requests MT6797 CONSYS power/reset, with CCF clock and watchdog reset delegation visible, but the complete selected transition-authority chain is not established.
consys_power_reset_owner.boundary: The power wrapper refuses a zero EMI base with -1; platform control returns its selected wrapper result. Register control requests watchdog bit12 assertion/release and clk_prepare_enable on the probe-acquired conn clock, but ends with zero rather than propagating that clock result. Source call sites do not certify effect success.
consys_power_reset_owner.missing: The exact selected CCF dispatch from the acquired conn clock to the MT6797 power-domain implementation and its full reset/resource lifetime exceed the bounded chain. No runtime configuration equivalence has been proved.
consys_power_reset_owner.next_discriminator: A separately scoped source audit of the exact DT conn clock specifier and CCF registration/prepare dispatch, with an explicit sufficient hop budget, followed by watchdog effect/return attribution.

wlan_to_common_handoff.claim: Firmware download has a local buffer lifetime and common-to-WLAN callback edges; no complete firmware-download-to-common ownership/lifetime handoff is established.
wlan_to_common_handoff.boundary: wlanProbe maps the firmware, calls wlanAdapterStart, then unmaps it and maps failure to -EIO. The visible implementation uses a local buffer; a nearby request_firmware variant is under #if 0. WMT's Wi-Fi callback caller maps callback failure to -1 and a missing callback to -2, setting its Wi-Fi bit only on success. These are separate partial paths, not a proved retained common-provider reference.
wlan_to_common_handoff.missing: The complete callback association, public WMT lifecycle and retained ownership through the precise download caller are not joined within the two-reference limit. The direction of the shown callback is common-to-WLAN, not evidence of the requested reverse edge.
wlan_to_common_handoff.next_discriminator: A separately admitted audit focused on the WMT callback assignment and lifetime/state machine connecting the firmware caller to common-resource retention and cleanup.

shared_remap_writer.claim: Common initialization calls a low-field OR writer and WLAN defines an upper-field remapper; the full caller/address chain to physical 0x10001340 is incomplete.
shared_remap_writer.boundary: Common initialization ORs the old register with base bits31:20 shifted into bits11:0 plus bit12. It preserves every previously set bit and does not clear stale low address bits. WLAN's helper preserves low16 while replacing the upper field after a value check. This does not establish locking or compatible concurrent ownership.
shared_remap_writer.missing: The selected physical mapping of topckgen_base/confRegBaseAddr to 0x10000000/0x10001340 and an exact caller of the WLAN remap helper were not established by the inspected locators. Literal offset and helper effects alone do not meet acceptance.
shared_remap_writer.next_discriminator: A new narrowly frozen audit of the exact DT resource tuple, of_iomap index and confRegBaseAddr assignment plus one real glRemapConnsysAddr caller; keep masked ownership separate from synchronization.

emi_region18_requester.claim: The WLAN divided downloader requests literal EMI region18 before and after copying, but its complete secure-adapter/raw-return chain is absent.
emi_region18_requester.boundary: The downloader uses base through base+512KiB-1 with region18. The EMI wrapper places region masked to five bits into bits31:27, invokes mt_emi_mpu_set_region_protection under a lock, ignores that return, and unconditionally returns zero; the downloader also ignores the wrapper return. A secure-call macro exists, but no inspected definition connects that missing adapter to it.
emi_region18_requester.missing: The body of mt_emi_mpu_set_region_protection is not in the frozen file allowlist. Thus literal18 cannot be carried through the actual secure adapter to raw status within this corpus.
emi_region18_requester.next_discriminator: A separate frozen source inventory selecting exactly mt_emi_mpu_set_region_protection and its direct secure-call edge/return conversion. Do not infer secure success from the unconditional outer zero.

linux_inference: A future common provider needs an explicit reservation lifetime, clock/reset ownership, shared-remap field coordination and status-bearing policy interface. This audit neither identifies an existing upstream provider nor selects its implementation or ABI.
